title: A-LEMS Sandbox Lock File
description: alems.lock schema. Records exact versions of every component used by this sandbox. Written by sandbox create and upgrade. Read at every run. Committed to git.

runtime_version.description: alems-platform package version of the engine that produced this lock.

core_schema_version.description: Highest applied core migration version number.

python.description: Absolute path to the engine venv python executable used to produce this lock.

install_type.description: pip = installed from PyPI. dev = development checkout pre-PyPI-release.

dev_path.description: Present only when install_type is dev. Absolute path to engine checkout.

locked_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this lock was written.

plugins.description: Every plugin loaded by this engine at lock time.

extension_schema_versions.description: Map of namespace -> highest applied extension migration version.
